verdict: SMS Agent Host (`CcmExec`) went non-functional after the Windows Management Instrumentation service was paused. WMI cancels pending callers on pause and does not re-establish them on resume, leaving CcmExec hung.
fix: Immediate: `Restart-Service CcmExec -Force`. The MECM client health check will also detect and restart the service on its next cycle (default 60 min). Long-term: avoid pausing `winmgmt`. If a monitoring agent or hardening script is pausing WMI, refactor it to stop/start instead, or exclude CcmExec from the pause-restart cycle.
